steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

notes: the notion-plus-miro alternative, self-hosted from the community edition: docs, whiteboards and databases in one workspace. upstream publishes the compose we run, so it is pinned by reference: fetched from the AFFiNE v0.27.4 tag and its floating :stable image rewritten to :v0.27.4 by a sed step, so a rebuilt machine gets the same server. honest gaps: redis and pgvector still float (the compose names them untagged), the first admin account is created by hand at /admin, and upstream asks for ~4 vcpu and 2gb ram, more than a small order carries. storage and config sit in compose volumes, so a freeze carries the workspace with the machine.
